about.title: About OnlineJob Portal
about.description: OnlineJob Portal is a modern employment marketplace built to empower job seekers and employers with smarter, faster hiring tools. Our platform brings together local talent, curated job opportunities, and career resources in one easy-to-use experience.
about.missionText: To empower every professional with access to relevant jobs, clear career guidance, and a seamless application journey. We strive to create a trusted hiring ecosystem that helps talent grow and employers hire with confidence.
about.visionText: A future where opportunity is easy to find and every candidate can connect with work they love. We want OnlineJob Portal to set the standard for transparent, inclusive, and efficient hiring nationwide.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How do I create an account?
faq.answer1: Click on Get Started and fill in your details. Verify your email to activate your account.
faq.question2: Is OnlineJob Portal free to use?
faq.answer2: Yes! Creating an account and applying for jobs is completely free for job seekers.
faq.question3: How do I apply for a job?
faq.answer3: Browse jobs, click on a job listing, and click Apply Now. Make sure your profile and CV are up to date.
faq.question4: Can employers post jobs for free?
faq.answer4: Yes, employers can post jobs after creating a company profile and getting admin approval.
faq.question5: How long does it take to get a response?
faq.answer5: Response times vary by employer. You can track your application status in your dashboard.
